## Runs
- Path: `/runs`
- File: `src/pages/runs.tsx`

Shows all runs with pipeline, status, timestamps, links to **Run Detail**.

## Run Detail
- Path: `/runs/:runId`
- File: `src/pages/rundetail.tsx`

Features:
- Lists artifacts (logs/configs/outputs)
- YAML/CSV/Excel parser UI
- Gene / oligo selection
